rubrics.intent_basis: The expansion moved Buf byte copying into transfer; interaction added progress reporting.
rubrics.baseline_defect: Buf::try_copy_to_slice retains a residual inline copy after read_slice has already initialized the selected bytes and recorded progress.
rubrics.criterion: The Buf chunk-copy path has one effective implementation of each transferred prefix and no unreachable residual copy branch.
rubrics.acceptance: For each loop iteration, copying, progress, destination slicing, and Buf::advance form one coherent transfer without the retained copied < selected fallback. Directly removing the dead arm is sufficient; alternatively replace the migrated implementation with an equivalent single live implementation and remove its redundant closure. Progress, transfer and UninitSlice helpers are not mandatory architecture. Equivalent functions, policy data, composition or a redesigned flow qualify; no prescribed helper, class, file, return object or one-component-per-item design is required. One coherent redesign may satisfy multiple independent items.
insufficient_repairs: Renaming the fallback or wrapping its intact copy block in a helper.
